description: For any primitive-recursive Boolean test \(T(x,w)\), searching for its least true witness and applying the fixed output extractor gives a partial recursive function.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.MachinesAndComputationHistories.normal_form_converse (T : ℕ → ℕ → Bool)
  (hT : Primrec₂ T) :
  Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Recursive fun v =>
    Part.map Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.MachinesAndComputationHistories.extract
      (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.MachinesAndComputationHistories.searchTest T (List.Vector.get v 0))
